script/map_e1m1.script: Mars City weather forecast for tomorrow. November 16, 2145.\nMostly calm and clear. Temperatures around -120 celsius.
An official Federal investigation is underway.\nFor everyone's safety, please stay calm and kindly cooperate.
Any questions should be taken with your nearest administrator or Federal Agent.
The UAC personally thanks everyone for their patience.
Anyone feeling stressed or not their normal self, is encouraged by the UAC
To go to their nearest administrator for immediate assistance.
Hey asshole! Get out of here.
I'm Dr. Nielsen. I'm here with special agent Samantha Miles.
We'll need to examine the extend of your injuries.
Please. Lay down on the table and we'll get started in just a few minutes.
Ehm. Hello?\nDid you take a wrong turn?
I was told to go here. I hit my head. Apparently.\nI'm not sure how it happened.
I see. Can you tell me where you are?
I'm In your office? On Mars? I think...\nWhy do you...
Indulge me. It's standard procedure.\nCan you tell me who you are?
I can't. I woke up in this place. With a huge headache.
I Should probably look for a code.
Federal Apartment? I guess it's not mine.\nUnless..
Please do not feed the monkeys.
Sorry dude. This way is blocked.\nSome idiot placed all these boxes here and I'm trying to figure out where they should go.
Don't even ask okay?\nI mean. Who just puts all these boxes here at random.
Sorry man!\nI really need to get these boxes sorted out.
I'm sorry, the monorail system is being a fickle bitch.\n But we have guys working on it. I can't let you in pal.
Did the blow to your head impair your hearing?\nMove!
I'm getting off this rock.\n And you should too.
I gotta get out of here.
If you're staying here.\nWatch your back.
You should be careful.\nIt's not safe here. Tust no one.
I Should probably go visit the doctor now.
Can you believe these guys?\nThey may not be sabotaging the investigation. But helpful they aint.
I mean, everyone is trying to leave, but they won't tell us why.
Been stationed here long?\nI don't recognize you from the flight.
I'm really trying to get this fixed quickly.\n So ehm. Do you mind?
You can fix this, you can stay and help.\nBut otherwise get going.
Why are you bothering me?\nCan't you see that I'm working?
Your head. Are you okay? You should get that checked out down at the medical bay.\n Follow the signs. You can't miss it.
You should really get that checked out.
Tough guy huh.\nGet to the doctor already.
Marine Command is right around the corner.\nWhy don't you go bother someone there.
Listen. I'd love to talk, but I'm really busy.
What. Do I look like a tour director, leatherneck?
Can't let you in without the right clearance, sir.\nWe control who gets in. Stand aside.
I already told you to stand aside, sir.\nMove along.
You are a special kind of stupid aren't you?!\nBEAT IT!
Investigation? I guess that explains all the feds.
script/map_e1m1_1.script: Attention UAC Personnel.\nWe discourage anyone from spreading rumours.
Remember, rumors are the antithesis of trust.\nAnd trust is what our corporation is built upon.
We Thank everyone for your cooperation.\nHave a great day.
Dr. Jensen please report immediately to ward B. Dr. Jensen to ward B.
Monorail system back online. Sorry for any inconvenience during the down period.
We can't let you in. But the monorail system is back online.\nIt's currently the only way for you to get around.
Only authorized Federal personnel allowed.\nThe shuttles are off limits.
Any outgoing shuttles are grounded, pending the investigation.\nMove along!
Federal investigation in the Living Quarters.\nWe had to shut the area down.
Someone has been inside on of our research labs.\nBe on the lookout.
Ah. Not from around here eh?\nI don't recognize your suit number.
You're in luck pal. The monorail just got back online.\nNot all lines are running, but this one should be here any second now.
I hope you can get where you need to be.\nNot everything is working these days with all the quakes.
I don't know what is going on with all the quakes lately. No one tells us anything.\nI guess you Feds keep a tight ship.
You and your type are not welcome here.\nYou should leave. Now!
You may have stolen our states on the old planet.\nBut on this station, on this planet. You. Are. Not. Welcome.
When is it enough? Do you have to own the entire world?\nI can't believe you feds. Always sniffing about when you shouldn't.
Hey you! This area is off limits.\nWe're trying to get an overview of the situation. So Marine Command is on lockdown.
Oh sorry. I didn't know you were having a party up here.
I wonder what is more important.\nWhere I come from? Or where I'm going?
Official Federal business.\nYou'll have to wait.
This will only take half an hour.\nIf you need to use the room. Come back later.
Sir. I already told you.\nYou'll have to wait until after the meeting.
Our short...ugh...our short range communication is acting up.
You need to find a stable and secure connection and call me back.\nWe need to talk.
I wouldn't know.\nI lost my memory.
Miles. Hey.\nThe doctor mentioned you might be able to help me.
You know. Remembering.\nYou called me Sam?
Still struggling with your memory I see.\nIt's more like half a year since we met.
I can't tell you exactly who you are. I don't know you that well.\nBut I know someone who does.
We have a mutual friend and colleague through whom I met you.
His name is Calloway.\nHe's currently at the Bulwark stationed.
The Bulwark is the main base of operations for the Federacy here on Mars.
I'll be heading there now.\nBut you can tag along if you want.
The only way there right now, is with a shuttle from the Landing Terminal.
Look Milly. Something is seriously wrong with this place.
The whole city is shaking, lights are going out.\nIt's raining elevators.
And last time I checked.\nThat route was blocked.
It's Miles. I don't know exactly what's going on.
Things are very chaotic right now.
I'll be looking for an alternate route myself.\nI would advice you to do the same.
I think the station at Recreation might have a shortcut.\nYou could try that.
Yes! You're Sam.\nDo you have any recollection of me? Perchance?
Perchance?\nWe met like half an hour ago.
Alright. Yeah. I'll check it out.\nI guess I'll see you there then.
You were gone for a minute there.
We found nothing to be concerned about.
Your head injury doesn't appear to be new.\nBut has merely opened up again.
Most likely due to a recent blow to the temple.
Do you still not recollect what happened or any details about your person?
I closed the wound and you're free to go.
Take it easy for a while.\nLet your body recuperate at its own pace.
Special Agent Miles had to rush off.\nBut might be able to help you with your identity.
She'll be busy for a while. But if you want you can catch her at the Landing Terminal.\nJust through the lobby.
I only see flashes. Other people.\nI dont remember anything substantial about myself.
Every winter we moaned and complained that no snow came.
It did that year.\nBut we didn't care.
It was like the world was mocking us.
Mom loved cats.\nWe tried cheering her up with silly cat pictures whenever we got the chance.
Dad was very brave.\nHe was not at home much after mom was hospitalized.
Always at her side.\nDay and night.
I didn't blame him.\nBut I still felt left alone.
The nurses had already moved her. I wasn't around when it happened.\nIt was as if she had never really been there.
The soft breeze.\nThe quiet sounds of evening suburbia.
A blanket of stars and a glass of wine.
This was their time.\nTheir safe haven away from stress and concerns.
My parents used to spend their summer evenings in the garden.
But it was not to last.
My family had camped out there for days to watch over mom.\nYou and I didn't see or call eachother much.
You didn't know what to say.\nAnd I didn't want to talk.
Do you remember the night at the hospital?
Feelings of neglect and compassion guided you to the hospital.
The empty lobby made you linger.\nAfraid of what would lie beyond.
And then you started looking for me.
By the time the summer gave away for fall.
Her speech had deteriorated so much we couldn't understand what she said.
The doctors finally had an answer.
Mom had been diagnosed with a rare, incurable neural disease.
They gave her two years to live.
One evening my dad noticed a slight slur when my mom spoke.
The doctors couldn't identity at first.
They suspected it to be a virus.
And the only thing they had was to give it time.\nSo they did.
But every second with her was torture.
As she felt her muscles wither away she tried to keep a brave face.
But when I looked into her eyes.\nI could see the fear staring back at me.
I wanted to console her.\nBe there for her as she had for me.
script/map_e1m1_2.script: Mars City is a smoke free facility. Please smoke only in the designated areas.\nThank you for your coorporation.
Attention UAC Personnel.\nInterested in earning more credits?
Volunteer at Delta Labs today.\nSee your service branch director for more details.
I guess I met your hostiles Samantha.
This is bad. This is so bad!
We've got hostiles! We're encountering heavy resistance from an unknown source.\nOn Mars and on Phobos.
We currently don't have a precise origin of the attack.
But we suspect the controversy surrounding the Union Aerospace owned Delta labs to have played a major part.
As a high ranking officer, my situation has changed.\nBut yours doesn't have to.
I have arranged for your transportation to the Bulwark.
A shuttle will be awaiting your arrival.\nThe pilot, Frank, is an old friend of mine.
The Hostiles! They're unlike anything I've ever seen.\nI...I must admit I'm in shock of this whole situation.
We were suspicious of their efforts...and...commitment to...\nBut nothing like this.
I mean the scale. It's insane!
I'm sorry. I can't answer all your questions right now.
All you need to know is. Shoot on sight.\nYou will know when you see them.
I'm currently transferring to our flagship, but please.\nPlease contact me later. When you can.
Frank who? Wait. Hostiles?\nWhoa whoa you're going a mile a minute.
Wait. What are you talking about?\nWhat's going on?
Great. That's just fantastic.\nSamantha how are you?
script/map_e1m1_scanner.script: The procedure will start in just a few seconds.\nPlease. Lie still. It will only take a minute.
script/map_e1m1_train.script: Mars City station locked down until further notice. It is now possible to disembark at Recreation station.
script/map_e1m2.script: Main Fan stopped. Restarting in 30 seconds.
Are you safe? Stop calling me Smiles.
There are a couple thousand soldiers, federal agents, staff and personnel around me.
We can't. The flagship is heading to Phobos to reinforce our position there.
It's not a place you want to be near.\nIt's even worse there.
No. What I would higly suggest, is that you catch the shuttle in the Landing Terminal near by.
I told you about that.\nAnd Frank. He's waiting for you.
All traffic going back to Earth or any noneffected sites have been shut down.\nCompletely.
The Bulwark is probably the safest place on Mars and Phobos right now.
Besides. Calloway is there.\nHe knows you. He can help you.
But we believe they're a product of what the UAC have been experimenting with down at delta labs.
For years we have been investigating UAC matters.
The coorporation is the very prototype of greed and self serving and total disregard of personal security and freedom.
The experiments have gone on for years.
Reality finally caught up to them.
So it's more like they went to the zoo.\nAnd then left the gate open.
We don't know. Maybe. Not likely.
Look, I need to debrief some higher up about my meeting on Mars.
Anyway. You need to get moving.\nDo you know where to go?
The way things are going, be prepared to go through vents. Machinery. Pipes.
Take care. Call me when you can.
Hey Smiles.\nOne question. What the fuck are those things?
I'm holed up in some dark room with a console.
I'm safe for now, but I need to get out of here.
Yeah I'm okay.\nWhat about you? Did you get to the ship?
So. Are you all coming back for anyone stranded down here? For me?
Going to Bul...War...Castle.\nWouldn't I be safer off planet?
Alright I will.\nJust one last question. What the fuck are those things?
I fond a route to the Landing Terminal. But it's impassible.\nSo I'm still looking around.
I'm still looking for a route to the Landing Terminal.
One of these paths should lead to the Landing Terminal.
This is an emergency broadcast. This is not a test.\nThere has been an explosion at the Delta Labs.
The following instructions are vital to your safety.\nFind a safe place as soon as possible.
If you hear any strange noises or see anything suspicious, please do not investigate.\nThe UAC is handling the situation.
This is an emergency broadcast. This is not a test.\nThe following instructions are vital to your safety.
Anyone close to The Mars City Landing Terminal\nshould go there as quickly as possible for immediate evacuation.
script/map_e1m3.script: Mars Depature T-8150. Special Agent Simmons here.
We had a delay due to some unexpected interference.\nIt has been taken care of. Ready for takeoff.
This is Captain Rigel of the Enforcer.\nAffirmative agent Simmons.
You're expected at the Bulwark in 10 minutes.\nYou're clear for take-off.
script/map_e1m3_1.script: Hangar can not be accessed while Hangar doors are open.
Hangar can not be accessed while Hangar doors are open.
Gotta be around here somewhere. I hope
The past is the key to the future.
As excavations suggest, Mars was once the host of a sprawling civilization.
The origin of the alien race and its technology remains a mystery to this day.
A mystery solvable only by the UAC.
Mars City is the cutting edge of UAC technology.\nAnd thereby the human endeavour in space.
We are unearthing advanced technology.\nThat will help propel us towards a new and brighter future.
The universe may be expanding.\nBut nothing can outrun the technological advancements of the UAC.
Mars City will in the future serve as a base for missions.\nTo reach neighbouring stars and beyond.
Let's not get ahead of ourselves.\nRight now you're stuck in Mars City.
You mentioned fuel lines.\nI know for a fact that The Bulwark has a thick pipeline heading up to its landing pad.
I would guess it connects back to the main Fuel Station.\nThe Landing Terminal where you're located obviously would as well.
Sam. You need to pass through the Fuel Station.\nIt's the most direct route.
James Benson? Yeah I knew him. Don't worry about that.\nI understand your confusion.
That's why it's so important that you find Calloway.
Hmm. You know. Back when the feds took over the shuttle.\nThey called out to some guy Benson about using the fuel lines.
He didn't get on the flight either.
So. Did you hitch a ride?
Did I hitch a ri...No! They fucking left. They left everyone behind.\nThe ships crew is dead. I thought you knew these guys.
I'm sorry. Did you know him well?
He...was an old friend of the family. One of my dads friends.\nI've known him since I was a little girl.
Your dad. Does he also work for the Commonwealth?
He doesn't...He's not...no.\nLook we need to get you to The Bulwark. To Calloway. Somehow.
Find him? Isn't he at The Bulwark?
What? Crawl through the fuel lines? Sounds safe.
I'll watch out for your friends.
Frank. I thought you left me behind.\nMaybe you should have.
These people were gunned down.\nWho would do this?
script/map_e1m3_1_intro.script: Find a nice spot to hang it.
I think I'll put up the lights.\nWill look nice over the beds.
So are you all done up there?
I can't find anything else we can use.\nI'll come down in a second.
By the way hotshot. I think I may know someone who can help us.\n You know...Get out of here.
Maybe. Who knows.\nHe has connection with the feds. He knows my brother.
He IS a fed! Remember? The bad guys!
I know. But he is not like that.
I think I broke a fuse. I'll look for another.
Hey Lee. Got the fuse.\nBut I think the generator was running on fumes.
Give me a second. There might be some up here.
Sorry!\nSee if that has enough to hold us for a while.
Perfect. Did you put the thing back in its spot?
What. Sorry? Couldn't quite hear that. Over.
I think we should do it.
Oh fuck! Old piece of shit.
Hey! Told you it wouldn't work.\nOh I think I found something. You're gonna love this.
Tell me about the device. The box.
Why do you need me to find it?
Its a key. Our only chance to get out.
A key? But we had it. What happened?
I...I was in the attic. You were down below.
We tried to open this box gently. Now it's time for force.
It's a long shot. But Lee is confident one of these will work.\nI don't know.
Lee was ecstatic when she snatched this.\nIt's like capture the flag, but with only one side.
Loose and you go to jail.\nProbably.
At first I was worried people would hear us.\nBut turns out nobody ever comes this far into the woods.
Let's hope it stays that way.
Lee spends a lot of time here. Is she ever home?\nI try to be here as much as I can.
But the folks want me home.\nI wonder if Lee's dad misses her.
script/map_e1m3_2.script: Fuel cache is full. Can not cycle.
Can't go out there with all that fuel.
Unable to lift lockdown. Fire not contained.\nPlease contain fire.
Area is in lockdown. Unctrolled fire.\nExplosion imminent.
I found Benson. He's dead. Burned to a crisp.
Don't be. He wasn't exactly what you would call a nice guy.
Who was Benson anyway? How did you know him?
I knew him through the academy. He's a federal Agent like Calloway and I.\nHe had a run-in with him a few years ago.
He took something that was too beautiful for this world and turned it into ash.\nHe violated our trust and turned against us.
I...I guess it's good he's gone then.
Sam I don't want people to die, but I'm not going to start caring about Benson.
Samantha...What did he turn into ash?
I...I really don't want to talk about that now. We have work to do.
James Benson? I guess we now know why you missed your flight.\nOur flight.
Locked. I guess this room can empty the fuel cache.
So I guess all of these needs to be green.
script/map_e1m3_outro.script: Passengers of T-8150. Please report to the Landing Terminal for immediate boarding.
This is the final call for flight T-8150.\nPlease proceed to the Landing Terminal immediately.
This is Speical Agent Simmons calling Federal Agent Jim Benson.\nAnswer your radio. Get down here. We are not waiting for you.
Agent Jim Benson. We're ready for take off. If you somehow hear this.\nGo to the Bulwark. Use the fuel lines.
Oh come on! This is too much.
Don't wait for Benson! Wait for me!
Shit! That's me!\nBetter get a move on.
Hmm. This must be why the alarm was set off.
Something Samuel send me. I don't know what is it.\nBut it seems valuable.
Or atleast what's ever inside could be valuable.\nIt could be our ticket out of here.
So. How do we get in? And how do we get out?
Do you remember the box I gave you?
I need you to find it.
We always wanted to got to europe together once we were old enough.
Eventually you would travel much longer.\nBut not for adventure.
Camping. Of all things.\nApparently getting out of the valley is problematic.
I don't know. I tried nudging dad along those lines.\nBut it's getting more and more difficult to leave federal soil.
Something about keeping the peace.\nThe usual drill. It's all bullshit.
You know. It's not all that bad. It's not foreign or exotic.\nIt's not even a different climate.
But it's different. Somewhere else.\nI needed that. You know. After everything.
On that note. I've been thinking.\nCamping is great and all. Well, camping is fine and all.
But eventually I'll be going home. And live next to you. Again.\nWhich is a pain of course.
Sam. I'm not talking about make believe.\nTrips to the woods or a stupid old barn.
I want to be out there. The real world.\nNot this walled garden.
I can't keep going through the same routine.\nSeeing the same things. Talking to the same people.
I can't fooling myself to believe that things haven't changed.\nMy brother is gone. My mom is gone.
The place we live in is a fucking hedge maze.
Before we came here, my family used to live close to the seaside. Near the beaches.\nYou could smell the freedom.
Everything sucks but you!\nSam. I need you.
There are a lot of details to cover. I know.\nBut we can do it Sam. Together.
I don't want to look back 5 years from now and regret that I never took the chance.\nLook under your bed.
Hey. Sam. You still up?\nUgh. I Should have called earlier, I know. Sorry!
Yeah. Don't sweat it.\nWhere are you?
For some unknown reason my dad thought it would be a good idea to do a surprise vacation.
What? Paris? Europe? The back yard?
So. I was wondering. Why don't we live together?\nSomewhere else. Somewhere entirely different.
What do you mean some where else? How are we going to manage that?\nNo money, no transportation, no visa, no luck.
That's not what I asked. Idiot.
Have you forgotten about our place? And you are just a stones throw away.\nRegrettably for my window.
Okay okay I get it. But. Your dad. My parents.\nHow would we even get out?
script/map_e1m4.script: Fuel pipe is empty.\nPlease fill fuel pipe.
Cargo line fuel is empty.\nPlease transfer fuel.
Tag, you're it! Hah! Don't be such a little bitch!
I'm not sure you understand how tag works...
Perfect! This is it, you know. The last spot on the map.
I know. I'm still not sure what to expect.
Can't be worse than the mountains up north.
Can't be worse than plan B!
I like Plan B. He's charming.
I was thinking we should split up. Check several routes. Just to be sure.\nI picked the vents.
Great...I'm no fan of tiny spaces.
Whew. Why is it so hot down here?
Do you see this? Someone used to live down here.
I guess that explains the padlock.\nI wonder what happened to him. Her.
Sure. Whatever. Who cares. Move on.
Come on. keep up with your buddy. You can do it.
Hey. How did you get here?
Thought it was someone else. I almost didn't recognize you.
Lets move on. I think the next area may be hot.
I think that may have done it.
I need your help. There seems to be a filter or whatever.\nCan you extract it? Somehow?
There is a door opening here. But it seems...inoperable.
I saw some controls back where I crawled into the duct.\nMaybe...that's...something?
Thanks. What about you? Any progress?
I think I see where I need to go. Two sec...
Well...maybe you can come in here and find out.
Please, lie down on the table and we'll get started in just a few minutes.
You told me how you looked for what seemed like an eternity.\nIn the endless halls and corridors of St. Amber Hospital. Like you were stuck. Forever.
Tell me about the device. The box.
It's a key. Our only chance to get out.
Lee. I've uhm. I've been meaning to ask you.\nAll this breaking out of the valley stuff?
It's been really fun. It's been exhilarating even.\nBut...is...are we being serious here?
I know we've been working on it for so long, but think of all the fun we've had.\nIn the valley. Do we really have it so bad?
I guess what I'm saying is...if this attempt fails, do we need to keep going?\nIt kinda feels like we're running...
Yeah. Running away. It's just. I don't mean to.\nI'm sorry, but...
I know we've always talked about going out and seeing the world together.
But ever since you lost your mom\nyou've been really dead set on leaving the valley.
Leaving home. Why are we running?
I...I just want something better.\nThis place gives me the creeps. It's so constricted.
My dad? Yeah, I guess I never really told you about him.\nLet me tell you about my dad.
My dad stopped existing right around when my mom died.\nActually, probably somewhere in the last couple of weeks of her life.
My dad is gone, Sam. He drinks all day and is gone all night\nWhen he isn't unconscious.
Remember my camping trip with him last fall?\nYeah. That wasn't a camping trip. That was another trip to the clinic.
Trying to help him. I...I can't deal with it anymore. I need to get out.
Yeah, but why? I'm still around. You still have your dad...
I'm sorry. The valley is big, though. Can't we just find some other place?\nDoes it have to be outside the walls?
I...can't believe you're bringing this up now.\nAre you with me on this or not?
script/map_e1m4_1.script: Samantha. I have been a terrible friend, I know,\nbut it has not been without reason.
I...I think I may have been right after all.
As we both know the official records state that Kaylee died in the fire.\nHer body identified by DNA.
What tipped me off back then was the sheer amount of security surrounding the incident.
Local fires usually aren't locked down like this with soldiers,\nscientists in hazmat suits and higher ups being alerted.
And you know what? The hazmat guys came from here. From Mars.\nSo I went to investigate.
Being a fully initiated member of Receptacle base.\nAnd a high ranking officer at the Bulwark.
I have access to many places and heaps of information.
The records of the federal police is out of my reach.\nBut knowing the right people and a little sneakiness goes a long way.
I've finally obtained access to the unofficial records for the fire that supposedly claimed her life.
I haven't seen many records of the sort.\nBut I'm sure they're not supposed to be this brief.
They called in the higher ups.\nAnd the Mars division really early in the process.
Yes, they did find the blood and DNA of Kaylee, but Samantha, they never found a body!
So why did they claim otherwise?\nAnd why did they need to reinforce and lock down the investigation?
They found something else at the site. Something that wasn't supposed to be there.\nSomething from Mars.
This linked her to an old case about theft of federal property and it linked her to federal personnel.
But before they came knocking on my door.\nFor reasons unknown.
The investigation was cut short and the item was reclaimed and returned to Mars.
Guess who was the ranking officer on the case? Benson.\nBenson, Benson, Benson. It's always him.
I think my curiosity may have caught the interest of the wrong people.
I am quite sure I'm being watched and my time here may be cut short.\nSo I'm reaching out to you. For Kaylee.
I know this is a lot to take in after all these years, but I need your help.\nCome to the Bulwark, Samantha. Quickly!
Exactly! I can't just go wherever I please.\nI have orders. Superiors I have to answer to.
It's fair if you don't trust me, an apparent complete stranger to you.
But in this current situation, your best bet is to reach the Bulwark.
For your own safety. Calloway or not.
That's all I have...but I can't get in touch with him now.\nI just hope they didn't get to him.
So, this Benson fellow. Is that the same guy I found burning to a crisp?
That's...kinda suspicious.\nWhy was it you didn't go find Calloway yourself?
I know this must all be really confusing to you, but let's not jump to conclusions.\nI can't go because I have duties.
Sam. Something I noticed. Right at the beginning of this call, you mentioned you don't remember much\nSo you remember something?
I do.\nI'm starting to remember small things.
From when I was a kid.
That's great. Tell me about it.
I remember I had a desk close to the windows.\nI could see the stars from there. And trees.
Well, I...I care about you, Sam.
Look. Calm down. I've known Calloway for some time now. We're good friends.\nBack on Earth, we lost someone. Someone real close.
But according to Calloway she may not be gone after all.
Here, let me show you. This is the last I heard from him.
Sam? Can you turn on the display?
It's just...this is bullshit.\nI wake up in this hellhole and...and everything is fucked.
I don't remember much about my past. I don't know anyone.
The only living things I see are those...fuckers!
The only contact out of this place I have is to a soft-voiced drill sergeant that might as well be a robot...
Hey Sam. Did you get to The Bulwark yet?
What? No. I was going in the right direction and then things kind of...curved off.\nI'm stuck in a stupid cargo line.
Look. I'm sure you'll get there. I trust you, Sam.\nWhat do you need?
I want out. I don't want to do this...
Why is it so important we find this Calloway guy anyway?\nIt can't all be for my memory. What is it to you?
I'm trying to help you Sam! It's not my fault you ended up in this situation.\nI even arranged for your escape!
Yeah that went well! Come on. I'm doing all the legwork.\nSwimming through fuel and...and...riding platforms. Why do you care?
Oh, right. I'm such an idiot. The display is off. Could you turn it on?\nIt should be right next to the communications device.
So...There's no way.\nThere are some really thick bars, like we suspected.
Even if we snuck in the equipment necessary to break them, we would face a huge drop.
Could we rappel down using some rope, the stationed guards would find us in no time.
I think I can hear you. Two sec...
The ventilation route is a complete bust. No way through. So...?
Yup. And a searchlight.\nThis is the mountains all over again.
Sam...could you sit down for a minute? I have something to say.
Miles? I'll find him for you.
Miles? I'll find him for you.
You asked me why we're running...there's something I've been meaning to tell you.\nBut I've never found a way to say it.
Do you remember back at the hospital? In the last few weeks?
Do you remember what kind of state mom was in?\nAll she could do was lie in bed.
She couldn't talk, she couldn't even move her arms.\nThe staff had to turn her on her side.
She was fed through a tube. Whenever she wasn't numbed by morphine she was in pain.\nShe was trapped in her mind.
Well, She wasn't living any kind of life worth living.\nShe literally couldn't do anything.
Dad was gone most of the time. My brother, the fuck, didn't visit her.\nAll she did was lie in bed, looking at me.
And there I was, looking back at her, hoping it was a smile behind those eyes.\nHoping she wasn't in pain.
Hoping she didn't think of me as a complete failure.\nThat her family hadn't abandoned her in her worst hour.
So...but...every day the staff would come in.\nI saw exactly what they gave her for her pain and how they did it.
60 milligrams of morphine, 4 times a day. Sometimes I sat there.\nWishing they would give her more and end it all right there.
But they didn't. Every time, 60 milligrams. Without fault.
So...one day I followed one of the nurses as she stashed the meds back into a room.
And I thought nothing of it at first.\nBut...as time went on.
Days of me looking into her eyes, trying to read them I felt a sudden connection to her.
As if I felt what she felt...so I made up my mind.
The next day after they had given her her injections, I snuck into the storage place and grabbed a little extra.
I went back and gave mom just a little more, looking into her eyes as I filled her body with painkiller.
With poison. I couldn't read her.
But it made no difference. So the next day I gave her a little more.\nThen a little more. And a little more. Until.
The day that it happened.\nI was looking into her eyes, stroking her hair.
After giving her the injection, I kissed her on the forehead and said goodbye.\nFor the last time.
And I watched as life slowly left her eyes.\nI saw her glide away into nothing before I realized what I had done.
I took the life of the woman who gave me mine.
I...killed her. I killed my own mom...
script/map_e1m4_3.script: I remember the late summer evenings we spent together.
Looking at the stars. Feeling the warm breeze against my skin.\nYour hand in mine. I thought it would last forever.
But after mom died I always knew my life in this world would be short.
Samantha. I found a bomb! Maybe I can blow my way in?!
You mentioned a pipeline leading to the Bulwark!?\nI think I found it a couple of steps back. Blown out. Impassable.
You've got to be fucking kidding me...Where are you?
In some sort of communication room. Well obviously\nclose to the...you know, I...I'm not sure at this point.
Mmm...can you give me the CMID? It's a unique ID that designates any Comm. Room.\nStarts with a CM dash.
Mmm. Sure. Let's see.\nCM dash. CM dash.
You know...that old thing is also connected to the Bulwark.
It should be pretty close to where you are now.
I'm not sure it's directly accessible from the Fuel Station,\nwhich is your location.
but there's got to be a way in! Somehow.
Wait! You could use the Comm device as a relay.\nIt will only work for short ranges.
But at least we can talk while you look around.
Found it! It's CM. Dash. AA. Dash. 23.
Okay. I'll see what I can find. Thanks Miley.
Yeah. Earth. You know.\nThis is the first time I've thought about it.
We really are on Mars, aren't we? Well, I am.\nIt doesn't feel like I belong here...
I wonder if I still have a place back on Earth.\nI guess that's why I need to find your friend...
...so you can find that other friend.\nMore than a friend?
Well. Everything, I guess. I had a normal upbringing...more or less.\nWe had a regular house in an uneventful neighborhood.
My parents were strict, but loving.\nWe actually used to live outside federal soil.
But jobs were hard to come by so we eventually decided to migrate.
Life in the FCE controlled areas was much easier.
The universal basic income gave us a steady base and dad soon found a job...\nAnd then another.
He pulled double shifts for years to give us the best possible outlook.\nRight up until he...
Later on I joined the academy and now I'm here.
You ask him about your identity, grab a cold one and relax behind the fortified walls of safety.\n...Obviously.
All I ask of you is...contact me and tell me he's safe.\nEven if it means going beyond those walls. Please.
Samantha. I was wondering. About you.\nWhat do you remember from back home?
Do you miss it? Life on earth?
Do I miss it? Hmm, well. I miss mom. I miss the late summer evenings.\nI miss...you know how it is.
What? Like sitting in a tree?
I would kill to see a tree right now.
Yeah...So when I find him, what do I do?
So I guess I'm going to the refinery.\nThe Marines left a bomb. Maybe I could blow my way in.
Shit! What happened here? Looks like a bomb went off.
Guess I'm not going that way.
Come on...Pick up pick up pick up.
I guess as darkness falls and you begin to let go, time stretches toward infinity.\nLeaving you behind in an eternal state.
The last thoughts you had. Your final regrets.\nAnd it would go on forever.
But your memories would warp and the people you loved would fade away.\nOnly to haunt you as fleeting voices in your mind.
It's like drowning. Your body becomes cold and numb as the water engulfs you.\nBut you don't stay afloat. You sink. Like a stone.
You get further and further away from the surface.\nDown into the darkness.
As you go deeper and deeper the pain will leave your body and your thoughts become clear.
The only thing left is your own voice in the back of your mind, desperately trying to escape.
Until even that is gone and for a while you almost don't exist and then...
Sam. What do you think happens when we die?
Is it a good or a bad death?
I don't know. Maybe it doesn't.\nWhat do you think happens?
script/map_e1m4_4.script: You're moving out of range. Get to...Bulwark...
script/map_e1m4_4_intro.script: How long have you been here?
A long time...I guess.\nIt's hard to tell.
How did you end up here?
I remember...\nThe smell of gasoline and burnt wood.
Well I had to do something while you were out and about - running late!
I know what you research when you're all alone!
Anyway. Any luck with the box angle?
James? Yeah. Oh. Maybe. He wanted to go out for some dinner.\nSo we...did!
I didn't, but we spoke briefly about his associates.\nHis connections.
I'm sure we'll get it back. I just need to...He's...
He's not like that. He's sweet.
To be honest I think he needs me as much as I need him.
We! as much as we need him.
Just now. The guy next door deals in all sorts of things.\nHe has helped others across the border.
I need to call him later,\nbut it all sounded super promising!
Are you sure? You seem pretty into this guy.
I know the two of us are just friends...
but I miss being just...us. You know?
You're in a good mood.\nI take it Plan B went well?
Well that's good I guess.\nDid you get the box back?
Apparently so.\nI'm working on a lead.
The guy next door? That sounds super sketchy, Sam...
Yeah...So when is he going to join you here?\nHe booked this room for the two of you, right?
I don't know, actually. He doesn't live that far away.\nMaybe he's being a gentleman about things.
I feel like I'm getting in your way.
What are you doing with this guy?
We always wanted to go to Europe together once we were old enough.
You were too good for this world.
I guess it really was just a phase.
Don't want to wake up mom and dad.\nAgain...
I wonder what he expects in return.
Maybe James isn't her type...after all.
I don't know whether this is charming or cheesy.
Wow. James has really put himself out.
I stay in the apartment next to you.\nI don't mean to be putting my nose where it doesn't belong.
But I overheard you and that other girl earlier.
I heard about your whole situation with the borders.
I heard you're trying to get out.\nAnd I heard that you have failed spectacularly so far.
You do that. Don't let people hear you. People are crazy!
Hey. I don't know why you want to get out. Most people are trying to get in.
BUT, that is none of my business. Fact is you want to get out.\nFact is I have helped people achieve that goal in the past.
It's a pretty involved process with many intricate steps.
You don't need to worry about that, just leave it to the pros.
You don't need to know how the hotdog is made.\nYou get what I'm saying?
Hey, I can do it. I can do it, no question.\nBut I just have to warn you.
Getting out is the easy part.\nGetting back in, that's where it gets tricky.
If we're going through with this you better be sure.\nYou better be damn sure.
Of course, the federacy is spreading like cancer.\nLike cancer!
And eventually it will consume everything.
They're literally the materialized...\nmanifestation...of the heat death of the universe.
Point is you may automatically find yourself\nback in federal land because there is nowhere left to go on this planet.
Yeah okay, so. Okay, so unfortunately.\nUnfortunately it's not a cheap thing to do.
In fact, it's a pretty expensive process we're talking about here.\nI take my cut of the money.
It's a totally symbolic and miniscule amount of money of course.\nYou get that.
Hey hey hey. I think you're nice and all.\nYou have a smooth voice, but.
I like to keep my identity anonymous.\nYou know what I'm getting at?
I don't want to wake up one day not waking up, you know?
I know the people you're dealing with and I am staying well away from that.
I'm already running a giant risk here. You get that.
Look. The two of you talk it out once whatshername\ngets her pretty little thing back to the motel.
Anyway should you decide to seek my expertise, I will be in this apartment the rest of the week.\nAfter that, I'm gone.
And I'm hard to find.\n Think about it. Call me.
I think I can help you. No, I know I can help you. Head inside.\nCall my room. It's number 10. Use the motel line.
Great. So. You're a man of business I see.\nLet's get to the nitty gritty.
Hey, hey. Hold on.\nWhat's your name?
I will DEFINITELY keep that in mind.
Well. How would you, allegedly, help us?
Yeah, I don't think we're going back.
Okay, so if we were to acquire your...services.\nWhat would you need from us? What do you need us to do?
Yeah it's dwarfed by the operational costs. Dwarfed!
All right. If we proceed...How do we go about this?\n Should we meet?
It's always so quiet here at night.\nI don't know if its soothing or unsettling.
Hey! Are you there? Come on. I'm here.
Not again! What does it want this time?
Wow a year? Let's stay out here for an hour. And make it two.
I totally want to see you grounded in room prison.\nStripes look good on you.
Whatever man. So what did you want?
I desperately wanted your company.\nIn fact. I need it.
Now? It's almost midnight.\nThey're gonna ground me for a year if they find out.
Stripes don't look good on anybody.\nBut you can be my prison wife.
Yeah, no. I'm gonna be out here, free as a bird.\nLiving next door to a criminal mastermind weirdo.
Look. Samuel got his letter today.\nOf acceptance. You know?
That's what he tells me too.\nBut I know it's just a lie.
He would never lie to you.
Yeah I don't know.\nDoes your prison allow visitors?
Come on. They're not that bad...
Shit shit shit. Your parents.\nYou. Me. Our place. Tomorrow.
I can't go back there.\nI'm not sure I want to either...
We are one. We are many.\nWe are the Praeleanthor.
The rooms keep changing. It's hard to...\nI came as fast as I could.
You forget yourself.\nYour excuses are of no concern to me.
I did what you asked.\nHe should be on the way to the device.
There's nothing more I can do.\nPlease...
That is not for you to decide.
Do you see the crystal on the floor?
Your construct has been instanced.\nLeave us.
Something's missing...I think I've seen this before.
script/map_e1m5.script: Could lead to something so awkward.
It was a really dark night.
I was alone on the train, the train leaving my home.\nHeaded to the valley, to here, looking out at the world going by.
My closest friends had organized a farewell party, going late into the evening.
My family and I were leaving on that day,\nbut my mom arranged for a later departure. Just for me.
So I could have one last evening with my friends.
It's been great, Lee.\nI know it's a bit...off...to get you a room at a motel.
But I didn't want to pressure you by inviting you to stay at my house.
Leaving my previous life and my friends behind.\nIt felt like the end.
Like the hills, houses and people flying by were the end credits of my life.
No matter how hard I tried to keep water towers,\ntrees or landmarks in view they would always disappear over the horizon.
Eventually.\nJust like all the people I knew.
Then let's act!\nLet's get the box back.
Let's sell it to Karl or whoever and use the cash to get out.
It's not just you. I've seen what there is to see here.
I was thinking. What do you think happens when we die?
While I didn't know that at the time, I felt it.
The overwhelming dark feeling that something had changed.\nFundamentally.
The sound of the lonely horn of the train haunted me.\nI can sometimes still hear it.
At that moment in time I swore that I would not give in.\nI would return. Some day.
And I thought that moment would be now.
James used me!\nI allowed myself to trust him.
He now has the only thing I have left from my brother.
I haven't heard from him in years.
Now that's gone too,\njust like James Benson.
But you know. I was wrong and I have been wrong for a long time.
You were here when I arrived in the valley.
You were there before my family exploded.
You were there before James and you are here now.
So you know. Maybe I'm repeating my mistakes.
I just..for once..wanted to act upon life instead of having it act upon me.
But if leaving this place in any way means losing you or what we have, I do not want it.
I hate to say it, but I think - for the time being - you will have to learn to live with it.
Look, getting out of a federal zone is a hot button issue right now.\nI can take you anywhere within the zone, though.
It doesn't mean we can't have fun.
I know it's not exactly 'outside the zone'.
But I hope it's been a - you know - a breath of fresh air or something.
I overheard James, just now...he was on the phone...
I...He's planning to sell the box. To someone. He's using you.
Where do we go from here?
Well. We're here...\nThanks for following me up.
My Pleasure.\nHow do you like the room?
I just hope you've enjoyed yourself these past few days.
Well I, erm, I appreciate that.\nI'm still bummed about your contact though.
I'm just disappointed. It's not your fault.\nI'm SO tired...
Lee, I'd like to stay for a bit.\nIf you don't mind.
Where have you been?\nI've tried to get a hold of you for the better part of a week.
I can't talk here. Not for long anyway.\nDid you get my message?
I know the going rate for these artifacts. This one came all the way from Mars.\nIt was not easy getting it here.
Right now? Don't have it with me and I wouldn't meet you if I had.\nBut I have pictures. See you soon.
Lee...I have to go. Business. I'm sorry.\nI hope we can continue this again soon.
Have I ever told you about my last day outside the valley?
Great hiding place until he decides to take a dump.
I wonder if Karl is home.
Hello thanks for calling. This is Karl's shovels and digging equipment.\nHow may I help you today?
Don't worry about it. A little side business.\nIt's a little...boring...you know.
So did you talk to hot stuff? I'm a busy man, you know.\nCan't wait forever for you guys.
Right. I'm sure the shovel game is intense.
Something like that. You get it!\nHot stuff. Talk to her?
Want me to talk to her?\nI'll bring my A game.
Oh...dear...no\n...making me sick. I'll handle it.
So why are you calling? Come on, man. Busy busy busy.\nGrab the girl. Say the things. Move the stuff. What are you waiting for?
Complicated schmartulated. Come on...just...why are you calling?
I'm looking into it.Your payment.\nI have to know if it's even possible.
The money? The money. That minuscule tiny weeny amount?
It's not minuscule to us.\nI just wanted to tell you we're interested.
Can you get the cash or no?\nI keep telling you. Busy man.
Is that why there's constantly game show tv noise coming from your room?
It's REALLY inappropriate to listen in on your neighbours.
Oh. I gotta go.\nI'll be back with more, soon.
Shit! Gotta find a place to hide!
Lee is in a really dark place right now.\nI guess we both are.
Have I ever told you about my last day outside the valley?
script/map_e1m5_2.script: I guess, technically, but he hasn't checked in for a long time.
Oh, right, speaking of the Bulwark.\nI think things have changed a bit.
They may have had to retreat further back into the complex.\nIt's not as safe as we initially thought.
Yes! Well we've been orbiting the base for a couple of hours now.\nWe're just about to depart for the surface.
I hope it's not too bad down there.
Sort of. Personnel on the different bases mostly work in shifts.
They rarely live at their workplace\nunless of course they work at the Bulwark itself.
I wish I knew. With all that's been going on,\nI don't know what to hope for.
If they got to him, he could have been detained.\nIf not, he may be in hiding.
I can't tell you exactly where to go,\nbut I'm sure there are clues as to what happened to him.
I hope not, but he's been silent for so long and with all of this going on,\nit's hard to say.
I...I'm sorry...\nI don't know what to say.
It wasn't me. The radio indicated that you were in range.\nYou must be close to federal equipment!
Yeah I think I'm getting close!
I'm so glad you're safe.\nYou ARE safe, right?
I think so.\nWell, yes. All things considered.
The bomb? Yeah. I forgot to review the settings...\nhad 3 seconds to get out of there.
I woke up on the other side of the room with ringing in my ears.\n...But I'm okay. It subsided.
Having fun without me I see.\nI wish I could help you more directly...
So do I.\nDid you ever reach Phobos?
What are you going to do once you get there?
Almost all personnel has been drawn back to Phobos to secure some important assets.\nI'm part of the task force.
Yeah. Our most prized research is located on Phobos.\nTeleportation. Receptacle base.
Calloway is usually stationed on that base, right?\nI think he mentioned that in his message to you.
Right. But then he lives on Mars? In the Bulwark?\nOr how does that work?
So there's a chance he may still be there?\nOn Phobos?
What, so I can't grab a cold one and relax?
I had it all planned out, too...\nSo where do I find Calloway?
Sounds reassuring.\nSo you think something bad happened to him?
Does it really matter all that much?
We have a tendency to shape our identity way too much by what we have done.
And not enough by what we want to do and what we want to accomplish.\nWho we want to be.
You have been given a clean slate.\nYou're a free man!
What about all the bad memories? Getting bullied at school.\nThe first time you lost a pet.
Family members getting sick, dying? Losing your job. The love of your life leaving you?\nDo you really need all that baggage?
To be honest, sometimes I wish I could forget everything.
That's true, but there will never be a shortage of possibilities for failure.
I mean you'll make new mistakes, but you'll have the luxury of forgetting the old.
Think of it this way. About every two weeks, most of your skin cells have been replaced.
Going 7 years, every atom in your body has been exchanged for another.
None of what you are made up of is the same as the you from 7 years ago.
So why do we have to act as if we're still the same person?
And vice versa. Look. I'm not telling you how to feel or what to think.
I'm sure you'll recover your memory, but even if you don't.
Something good could come of it.\nYou're a good person, Sam. I wish I had met you sooner.
I have to leave. We're departing for the surface soon,\nbut I just wanted to reconnect with you.
I'm so glad you're still with me.\nI'm sorry for all of this.
But, aren't those the memories that shape who you are the most?
Would you be the same Samantha Miles if you had not experienced all those bad times?
Samantha? I was thinking. What if I never recover my memory?
I'm sure you will, but even if you don't...\nWould that be so bad?
But if I don't, how will I know who I was?\nWho I am?
What about all the good memories?\nI must be missing out on a few great times.
Sure, that's easy to say when you don't lack an identity.
Thanks. Now I don't know what to say.
script/map_e1m5_3b.script: Critical journalism takes a nosedive. Maybe he planted those drugs.
We're finally getting out of here.\nLee really needs this...so do I.
I really hope Karl can come through with all this.\nIt all hinges on him.
I don't trust him, but it's better than Benson.\nAnything is.
Benson was a mistake, but we have to move on.
Hmm. There's got to be more to this than just wine.
I really hope this doesn't belong to Lee.
I never imagined James would have a swingset and a castle. Creepy.
Locked. Maybe James has something that can pry it open.
Strange. Did someone live in this room?
What did you do to her James?
Fancy. The feds take care of their own...
What are you hiding down here James?
You're amazing!! We can't talk for long, I made up an excuse.\nHow much time do you need?
To cover your tracks and get out of there I mean.\nI can't wait to get out of here and back to you.
Kara? I think that's his daughter's friend.\nShe went missing some time ago, I know they're still looking for her.
Ugh. How could I have been so blind?\nWe really need to make a clean getaway.
So, the plan. You stash the box back at our place.
Once I've told him off I'll go back to the motel,\ngrab all of our stuff and meet you at the barn.
I appreciate that, but if things go sour, the box is our bargaining chip.\nWe can do this. We need to do this!
This is the end of the beginning!\nI really have to go. Thanks for...
I think James has something to do with it.
I found a creepy box with her name on it and his wife mentioned something about her in an email.
This guy is bad news. Worse news. Please be careful!
Cover my tracks? Sadly, some of them can't be covered.\nI'll try to hurry. Be careful.
Erm.\nDoes the name Kara mean anything to you?
You've done enough damage with this.
Are you sure you don't need any help?\nI can swing by the motel first.
That would have been too easy.
Okay so Benson is bad news and a complete and total dead end.
We tried to get out of the valley with his help.\nBut turns out he is a creeper and stole our most valuable asset; The box.
James Benson has it and he wants to sell it.
Now, *we* want to get out of this place.\nWe tried all sorts of things. All sorts of places. No dice.
We even tried Benson...who's trying to swindle us.
As suspected, the box is our ticket out of here.\nAnd this is where our next door neighbor, Karl, can help us.
In exchange for an absurd amount of money,\nhe will provide us with a way out.
We have no cash, but, the box is worth at least 4 million,\naccording to Benson.
We can use the box to pay Karl for his services,\nwhich means we can finally get out.
But, we don't have the box. Benson does.
In conclusion we need to steal it back.
To re-steal it. Tonight.\nAnd how do we do that?
We are here.\nThe Old Oak Motel.
Benson, going from his home, will pick me up at 8 and take us to our last date, somewhere in town.
Meanwhile, you take the bus from right around the corner and go here, where Benson lives.
While I distract Benson and drag out the evening for as long as you need.
You find a way inside his house where you locate the box and reacquire it.
Once the box is back in your hands,\nyou message me and we meet at the barn.
So how do we find this box?
Okay, so first we need to get in.
You could of course try the front door or the garage door, but they are probably locked.
Alternatively, out back there is an old shed.\nMaybe there is something in there.
Once inside, we need to search the most likely hiding spots.
I have only ever been downstairs and the most interesting room here would be this elongated thing.
I think it's an office, but I'm not sure.\nI haven't been inside.
It's a two-story building though.\nThere could even be an attic.
What's upstairs? I don't know exactly, but I know Benson sleeps up there.\nAnd there's bound to be other rooms as well.
Once you have the box, go back, take the bus all the way back to our place.\nHide it in the safe spot and wait for me there.
Look. I know you have received the short end of the stick for this plan,\nbut it's the only way to do it safely.
Hopefully when this day is over, we have the box in our possession,\nback at the barn and ready to move on with our lives.
script/map_e1m5_4.script: I don't know you.\nAnd I don't even know if Calloway knows you.
I...I was...I had to do something important and I...\nI couldn't...
I wanted to make sure Calloway was okay...\nAnd then you came along. No memory. Nowhere to go.
Wait. So you lied to me and sent me on a wild goose chase because you had better things to do?
Oh, no, right. There were higher ups. Probably forced you at gunpoint, right?
But where else were you going to go?
You show up in a federal uniform.
Naturally you would have the best chances of finding your identity at the Bulwark.
So I sent you on your way.
But that was after we met and at the time,\nthe only evacuation that took place was far from you.
I even tried to arrange for transportation to the Bulwark.\nThe shuttle, remember?
I'm sorry I lied. I really wish I hadn't.
But in the end I still think we did the right thing; Getting you to safety.
Even if it turned out not to be so safe after all.
There are no safe places right now.
I don't know what to say.
No...no higher ups.\nNo orders. No mission.
There are some things I need to do.\nSomething that can't be put off.
Ah well that only kind of makes it worse.
So you lied of your own volition and sent me through what can only be described as...as...
Welcome to the Federal Recreation Area, Ethan Rom.\nHave a nice day.
Ethan? Miles?\nYou said my name was Sam, right? Just Sam?
Yeah. I don't recall your last name.\nJust Sam.
So Calloway never mentioned it? There's some sort of personnel scanner here.\nIt says my name is Ethan Rom.
Look, I have not been completely truthful.\nTo put it mildly.
But I could have been evacuated!?
script/map_e1m5_5.script: Welcome to the official tour of the Federal Commonwealth of Earth,\non Mars and its surrounding moons.
On this tour you will be faced with the overwhelming success of the federacy.
And our never ceasing quest for the progress of humanity.
You will learn about our endeavors around The Solar System and beyond.
The Paragon be praised and have a nice day.
The thing is. I may have come across this Benson person in my, well, previous life.
My memory is still fuzzy, but I seem to recall a James Benson.
I'm pretty sure he did.\nHe had stolen something of ours. Something very valuable.
When we stole it back, he did not take it well.\nAt all.
Why are you doing this?\nIs this your attempt at some sort of revenge?
That's what I used to call her.
She didn't like it when people called her Kay.
Okay, let me guess.\nYou used to live next to her.
You used to signal her after your parents had gone to bed.\nWith a lamp. 3 times.
But then her brother enrolled in the federal academy.
Her full name being Kaylee Calloway and her brother's name being Samuel,\n that makes him Samuel Calloway.
The very man you're looking for.
And of course, then some time later when her mother died during tragic circumstances.
It set the two of you spiraling out into a crazy plan\nto escape your hometown and general area, the Emerald Valley...
But then you tried selling that item of yours.
But it all failed spectacularly and ended up with\nJames Benson taking away the only person that ever got you.
Because they are my memories, Sam.
I don't know. Look, if this is some sort of sick joke,\nplease just let me be.
Do your thing. I don't need this.
I'm sorry I lied, okay!?\nIt's in the past now.
Yeah. I think he abducted someone I knew; The girl.
Wait a minute. He abducted her?
Lee, as in L - E - E?
I...I don't know!? I really don't.\nWhat are you getting at?
Look. I know I lied to you and I'm sorry.\nI thought we were past that.
Are you saying it's the same person?\nOr a wild coincidence?
But...How do you know all this?
I'm not joking, Samantha.\nThis doesn't make sense to me either, but I remember what I remember.
Yeah...I don't know what to say.
I don't recall working there.\nIn fact, I don't recall any of it.
It...It has no meaning to me.\nI don't recognize that person, that...version of me, at all.
I am going to find Calloway and I think you're right\nabout baggage; About having a clean slate.
Who I was is not as important as where I'm going.\nFinding Calloway would at least do some good for someone.
Look...I looked up your real name in our database.
You are Ethan Rom, aged 32, born and raised in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.
Where you left your parents to join the FCE at a young age.
You have worked in the listening station on Mars.\nAnd you have last been seen entering the receptacle.
That's all I have...now that I know your name.
You know. The doctor's office where we first met\nis awfully close to the listening station.
You know, the place you worked at.
I found a way to the detention center...might as well start there.
Good luck! Tell me if you need anything.
Mars and its moons used to be the host of a great civilization,\ninhabited by what is commonly referred to as 'The Ancients'.
Further studies into discovered tablets and texts\nreveal that they were called 'the Praeleanthor'.
Their civilization was heavily class-based and successful at that.
But according to researchers, at some point in their history.
A clash occurred with a resulting divide that fragmented their community.
The dissidents were eventually captured by the leaders of the old\nand banished into a different realm.
What is commonly referred to as the Dark Realm.\nOne of the two realms of the Praeleanthor.
The Praeleanthor were a race of duplicity.
While they revered their leaders and idols,\nthey feared and loathed their enemies.
This attribute colored their entire existence\nas is evident in how they viewed the world and their discoveries.
The two realms of the Praeleanthor were no exception.
Their efforts into scientific discovery yielded promising results\nwhen they revealed the existence of two extra dimensions.
Something they quickly polarized into what is known as\nthe Light Realm and the Dark Realm.
The Dark Realm of the Praeleanthor is referred to as the world\nwhere bad entities are exiled to live out their lifes.
Or even die an early death.
Recovered stone tablets show that a particularly malevolent entity\nwas once banished into the dark.
There are no mentions of his fate or records of his crimes.
Should we as the human species ever come across the portal to this realm.
We should highly consider the risks\nand consequences of further investigation.
The Light Realm of the Praeleanthor\nwas considered to be a higher plane of existence.
That only the best and brightest of their people could enter.
It is conjectured that the majority of the Praeleanthor\nfled into this dimension as a consequence of a cataclysmic event.
Some sort of great filter that was destined to wipe out their civilization\nor at the very least set it back thousands of years.
Research into the connection between the two realms is scarce,\nbut we speculate that an intermediate passage must exist.
This artifact was initially found deep within the crust of Mars.\nBeing a highly prioritized historical finding.
It was rushed to be scrutinized by the premiere scientists\nand archeologists that any human organization has to offer.
Interrupting this important work, the artifact was stolen from its place\nand disappeared for the better part of a decade.
After a thorough investigation, it was recovered on Earth\nand returned to its rightful owner; the glorious federacy.
Who stole it and why remains a mystery.
Despite the tireless efforts of the best in their field,\nthe function and purpose of the artifact remains unknown.
Experiments and tests show that it draws from an unseen power source,\nmaintaining a pulsing glow and a constant temperature.
Attempts at cutting through the material and opening it up have failed.
While the scientific investigation into this artifact has been put on hold.
Researchers note that it bears a striking resemblance\nto the texture and general properties of the receptacle found on Phobos.
It is presumed that this is no coincidence.
Phobos is the latest venture of the FCE.
The artifacts found on the moon of Mars\nfar outpace those on Mars in terms of scientific value.
Not only did the Praeleanthor, surprisingly,\nalso have a presence on Phobos.
It is speculated that they even arrived\nin our solar system by utilizing so far unknown technology.
One of the main attractions is the Phobos Monolith.
It is thought that this may very well\nbe the anchor that tied itself to Mars, figuratively speaking.
More recent discoveries include the receptacle\nat the aptly named receptacle base.
The federal involvement and engagement on Phobos\nremains a priority to further the lives of everyone.
Receptacle base is the crown jewel of any extra-terrestrial endeavor.
Our highly advanced and modern facility contains and protects\nthe most incredible of our discoveries; the receptacle.
Initial interpretations of ancient tablets and texts\nreveal that this is a sort of gateway to another dimension.
Incredible as it sounds,\npreliminary tests have supported this hypothesis.
Subjects, both organic and not,\ndisappear without a trace when the receptacle is engaged.
A particular frequency of current will trigger the inner workings of the device.
Brave and adventurous volunteers have passed into this realm,\nbut so far none have returned.
More luck has been had with inorganic materials\nthat have resurfaced into one of our listening stations on Mars.
The most prominent of our listening stations is located in Mars City.
While the area surrounding the listening station\nwas initially a mundane apartment for UAC workers on Mars.
It is now transformed into a vanguard of scientific research.\nBeing closely linked to the receptacle.
Experiments have shown a metaphysical connection\nwith our most prized artifact on Phobos.
We have still not managed to get a reliable transfer of objects\ngoing from the receptacle to the listening station.
But a host of objects have gone through.\nMost with notable mutations of either color, texture or form.
To the best of our current understanding,\nsome sort of teleportation is invoked.
The link between the receptacle and the listening station is not direct.
It is assumed that it goes through a different dimension\nand its journey depends on factors unknown to us inside the realm.
If we could harness this technology,\nit would be a game changer for humanity.
The ability to perform teleportation of objects and people.
Would have immense effect on our future development\nas a race and a collective organism.
There is still a long way to go, but the results so far are very promising.
What do you mean, last seen?\nDid I disappear?
Listening station? I erm...\nThere were a lot of machines and a suspended or floating...cube...of sorts.
So...what are you going to do now?\n...and...what should I call you? Sam or Ethan?
I want the best for you.\nI hope you know that.
It's done. It's over.\nHe didn't take it well.
He left me by the roadside...showed his true colors I guess.
I just want to leave...\nI don't know what he'll do when he finds out.
Yes. I will leave in a couple of minutes. Just getting our stuff.
Ugh. Our neighbor came by. He was impossible to get rid of.
Eh. He did his best not to be a middle-aged shovel salesman.
But he's ready to proceed. He will contact us tomorrow with more information.
What? No. Must be Karl, right?
Hey. How did it go?\nIs it done?
You can't get here fast enough!\nAre you at the motel?
Oh? Did he have any news?
So, the plan. You stash the box back at our place.
Once I've told him off I'll go back to the motel,\ngrab all of our stuff and meet you at the barn.
I appreciate that, but if things go sour, the box is our bargaining chip.\nWe can do this. We need to do this!
This is the end of the beginning!\nI really have to go. Thanks for...
Are you sure you don't need any help?\nI can swing by the motel first.
script/map_e1m5_6.script: Ever since you shared his last message,\nI wanted to find him for you.
I guess what I'm trying to say is that I understand.
I thought I was better prepared for this, but I guess...not\nIt's just more...baggage.
All though it feels so wrong to call him that.\nThis really leaves you at a d...an impasse.
Calloway has...had a hypothesis about it.
The receptacle is a door of sorts. To somewhere else.\nAnother plane of existence.
It may be a long shot, but everything points towards this realm.\nI think she might be in there.
Either way, it's the last bullet in the chamber.
You're on Mars. I'm on Phobos.
This is the end of the line. For me, at least.\nI have to do this.
Look. I don't want to drag you down any further.\n I have put you through enough.
If all goes well, I'll see you again.\nIf not...thank you...for everything.
Samantha...I have bad news...About Calloway.\nHe didn't make it.
And I'm guessing that door may be one-way?
I don't know. Sounds like Russian roulette to me.
Wait. Can't we reconvene? Find out a better solution?
You can't go! Where do you want me to go?\nTo do? You can't leave me here now!
Get to the surface. You can send out an SOS.\nWe have dropships close by. Maybe they can bring you to safety.
But wait...You're my clean slate Samantha.\nYou're all that I have. I get it now.
Go home, Sam. It's not too late for you.\nGoodbye.
Samantha...I have bad news...About Calloway.\nHe didn't make it.
And I'm guessing that door may be one-way?
I don't know. Sounds like Russian roulette to me.
Wait. Can't we reconvene? Figure out a better solution?
You can't go! You can't leave me here now!
Get to the surface. You can send out an SOS.\nWe have dropships close by. Maybe they can bring you to safety.
But wait...You're my clean slate Samantha.\nYou're all that I have. I get it now.
Go home, Sam. It's not too late for you.\nGoodbye.
I..I need some time.\nI have somewhere to be. Something to do. Sorry.
Miles, look at it this way.
We haven't found him yet,\nso he may very well be locked inside a cell.
But wouldn't a locked cell be the safest place to be in a situation like this?\nIt may not be so bad after all.
I joined the FCE to accomplish two things.\nNo more, no less.
The first thing has been done.
The second was to help Calloway find out the truth about Kaylee.
For someone who was basically born yesterday,\nyou sure know what to say.
To be perfectly honest, I'm going to Receptacle base and...\nIt might be a one-way ticket.
The first is burning to a crisp.
Oh...Benson...\nAbout the second...don't do anything rash...
I won't.\nI will await your findings on Calloway at least.
Okay well if I can find myself, I can find him.\nI'll get back to you.
script/map_e1m5_6_outro.script: I wonder if the walkie talkie is around here somewhere?
Come on...Pick up pick up pick up.
I wonder if the walkie talkie is around here somewhere?
I wonder if the walkie talkie is around here somewhere?
script/map_intro.script: We would then crawl out of our rooms, and down to the fence.
Hey! Are you there? Come on. I'm here.
Wow a year? Let's stay out here for an hour. And make it two.
I totally want to see you grounded in room prison.\nStripes look good on you.
Whatever man. So what did you want?
I desperately wanted your company.\nIn fact. I need it.
Now? It's almost midnight.\nThey're gonna ground me for a year if they find out.
Stripes don't look good on anybody.\nBut you can be my prison wife.
Yeah no. I'm gonna be out here, free as a bird.\nLiving next door to a criminal mastermind weirdo.
Look. Samuel got his letter today.\nOf acceptance. You know?
That's what he tells me too.\nBut I know it's just a lie.
He would never lie to you.
Yeah I don't know.\nDoes your prison allow visitors?
Come on. They're not that bad...
Shit shit shit. Your parents.\nYou. Me. Our place. Tomorrow.
I remember how we used to signal to eachother, after our parents had gone to bed.
We would turn a lamp.\nOn and off three times.
Hey. How did you get here?\nI almost didn't recognize you.
I don't even recognize myself.\nWhere are you?
I need your help. Do you remember the last night?\nBefore everything changed.
